text:
Maya: dropping a quick thread on the compare table tweaks. new mock: https://redwood.mock/compare/v2. Main asks: column pin affordance, sort state clarity, and shorter badge copy for performance.
Devon: Love the pin idea. Two suggestions: 1) pin should be a toggle on the column header (icon-only ok) with an accessible label; 2) when pinned, the column should get a subtle sticky shadow so users notice it stuck.
Ravi: For copy, prefer 'Pin column' -> tooltip 'Pin column to keep visible while scrolling'. Avoid 'lock' verbing.
Priya: Sorting: current arrow indicators are tiny. Can we add text fallback like 'Sorted by latency desc' in an offscreen element for screenreaders? aria-bot could confirm best practice.
aria-bot: Recommendation: include `aria-sort` on header cells (ascending/descending). Additionally provide a live region update `aria-live="polite"` when sort changes, with text e.g., 'Sorted by Typical latency, descending'.
Maya: Good. About badges: mock shows 'p50 120ms' as the badge label. Feels dense. Proposal: surface '120 ms' and a tiny hilite 'typ.' or an icon to indicate metric type; full details in tooltip (p50/p95/n).
Devon: That reduces clutter. Ensure badge contrast meets AA at small sizes. Also add an optional compact view where badges are hidden behind a hover action.
Ravi: One more: when users pin a model version (not column), copy in the confirm modal currently says 'Variant pinned'. Change to 'Model version pinned for this project' and show a small line 'If this variant is unavailable we will fall back to a compatible variant.'
Priya: Keyboard flow: pin/unpin must be reachable via header menu (Enter to open, Space to toggle). Also ensure focus goes to the next logical header after action.
Theo: UX nit on mobile: pinned columns should collapse into a separate horizontal scroller at top rather than forcing side-by-side sticky columns.
Maya: Action list: (1) use icon-only header pin with `aria-label="Pin column"`, sticky shadow when active; (2) implement `aria-sort` + aria-live update for sorts; (3) badge surface -> '120 ms' + tooltip with p50/p95/n; (4) change modal copy for pinning model versions; (5) mobile: pinned horizontal scroller.
Devon: I'll draft the microcopy and hand off to design for updated symbols.
Ravi: I'll add acceptance criteria for keyboard and screenreader behaviors in the ticket.
Maya: Aim to have Figma updates and copy by end of week so eng can pick up next sprint. Thanks :purple_heart:
